title: CS 4535: Declare Your Target Band
description: Due Thu Oct 1, 23:59 ET. Change it in either direction through Thu Dec 3 by submitting again, with no penalty.
completedHtml:
Band declared.

You can change it any time through Thu Dec 3 by submitting again. Checkpoint 1 on Wed Oct 14 reads your work against the band and options you chose here, and tells you whether you're on track.

elements.name: band_note
elements.html:
Declare the band you want, not the one you're confident of. Declaring Distinction now and finishing at Credit costs you nothing that finishing at Credit would have cost anyway. If you're running ahead of your declared band, we'll tell you to raise it.

The requirements for each band are in the syllabus. Each band includes everything in the band below it.

elements.name: band
elements.title: Which band are you working toward?

choices.text: Pass (B): trusted to contribute under review
Credit (A−): trusted to exercise judgment, not just execute
Distinction (A): trusted to own what ships
High Distinction (A, plus what a reference letter can say): trusted to extend the system

elements.name: distinction_options
elements.title: Which Distinction requirements are you aiming for?
elements.description: Distinction needs four of the five. Pick four, or all five if you're going for every one.

choices.text: A feature owned end to end, through deployed and monitored
A design decision documented and defended in review, with the tradeoff named
Work delivered through your cross-project function, outside your own project area
Evidence about users, gathered and then acted on
A code review checklist entry you proposed, with its citation and what it would have caught

validators.text: Distinction needs four of the five. Pick at least four.

elements.name: d_feature_artifact
elements.title: Feature end to end: which feature, as far as you know today?
elements.description: Optional. One line. It's fine if this changes.

elements.name: d_design_artifact
elements.title: Design decision: which decision do you expect to be the one?

elements.name: d_function_artifact
elements.title: Cross-project function: what do you expect to deliver through it?

elements.name: d_users_artifact
elements.title: Evidence about users: what kind, and from whom?
elements.description: Optional. One line. What counts depends on your project, and Checkpoint 1 is where we settle it.

elements.name: d_checklist_artifact
elements.title: Checklist entry: what failure do you have in mind?

elements.name: hd_option
elements.title: Which High Distinction requirement are you aiming for?
elements.description: High Distinction needs one of the four.

choices.text: Something in the January 2027 handoff that another course depends on, with the ops playbook to run it
A subsystem or tool the maintainers keep after you leave
A measurement that settled a question the team was answering by assumption
Somebody else made more capable, to the point that they now do unsupervised what they needed you for

elements.name: hd_artifact
elements.title: What do you have in mind?

elements.name: constraints
elements.title: Anything we should know when we read your work against this band?
elements.description: Optional. For example, a co-op interview week, or a reason you're choosing a lower band than you'd like.
